title: LearnOps cues (B6.2, v1)
description: The cues.json file in a lesson folder (PRD B6.2): a bare JSON array of {t, type, ref, label, required?}, the moments where an activity should appear (FR-X-12). An empty array is valid. A lesson with no cues may also leave the file out. The supported v1 types are h5p (ref: Moodle activity idnumber, EXT-06), image (ref: path relative to the lesson folder) and url (ref: absolute https address; C-08 does not apply to it). The type is a token in the form of a track role (the manifest slug): lowercase ASCII letters and digits separated by single hyphens, so underscores, dots and spaces are rejected. The schema accepts any such token so a later release can add a type without changing v1; a v1 reader ignores a cue with a type it does not know. A branching scenario is a B7 practice item and uses h5p.
$comment: Unknown fields are allowed on purpose (PRD B.0, EXT-02). NOT expressible in JSON Schema, so NOT enforced by this file: that every t is at most the manifest's duration_s (another file, so a consumer-level rule); that an h5p ref names an activity that exists in the course; that a url is on the player's allow-list (the player checks it, FR-X-12); that an image file exists. The type-specific ref rules below apply only to the three supported types; for any other token the ref is just a non-empty string.

relative_path.description: The relative-path rule of the lesson manifest (contracts/lesson-manifest.v1.schema.json, $defs/relative_path; PRD B6.3, C-08), copied here with the same pattern text so that this file can be used on its own. A test fails if the two patterns differ. The path is relative to the lesson folder.

https_url.description: An absolute https address: the scheme https (any letter case), a host, no whitespace or control character. Whether the host is allowed is for the player's configuration.

t.description: Seconds from the beginning of the main track, at least 0. Fractional seconds are allowed. The moment the cue fires.

type.description: Lowercase ASCII letters and digits separated by single hyphens, the form of a track role (the manifest slug). Underscores, dots and spaces are rejected. Supported in v1: h5p, image, url.

ref.description: What to show. Its form depends on type: h5p an activity idnumber, image a path relative to the lesson folder, url an absolute https address.

label.description: Learner-visible text for the cue. Required and not empty. No length limit in v1.

required.description: true: the learner cannot skip the cue. Absent means false.

ref.description: The Moodle activity idnumber (EXT-06). Its form is not restricted here.
